research_question: How is Grade 8 achievement in TIMSS 2023 Data and Probability associated with students' access to home educational resources?
comparison: Data and Probability main multilevel model
evidence_statement: In the primary multilevel model, a one-point increase in the Home Educational Resources scale was associated with a 14.56-point higher Data and Probability score (95% CI 14.17 to 14.95) in the pooled 44-system analytic sample.
limitation: Results describe associations in the pooled 44-system analytic sample and do not establish causation or identical system-specific associations. Standard errors and 95% confidence intervals are model-based and should not be interpreted as full TIMSS JK2 design-based standard errors. The equal-system-contribution weight is a candidate model weight.
